newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says budget position could improve.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says budget position could improve.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the government's budget position could improve in the current year ending June 30, 1998.
Costello earlier released budget outcomes for the year to June 30, 1997, showing a lower than expected underlying budget deficit of A$4.934 billion and a headline budget surplus of A$2.514 billion.
Referring to the better than expected 1996/97 budget outcome, Costello said: "This is a better than expected result but it is too early to tell whether this could be a one-off improvement.
"It may not feed into the 1997/98 year, but if it indicates the base has improved the budget position could improve in 1997/98," Costello told reporters.
He said the government would not be updating its underlying budget forecasts until the mid-year budget review, due later in calendar 1997 or early 1998.
